description: Sets up Clio billing on up to 50 matters: open date, Case Value, flat fee, fee entries. Does not create a bill or apply a payment. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

case_value.description: Case Value in dollars. Defaults to the fees before the 4% card charge, rounded down to $50.

confirm.description: false or omitted returns a preview; true applies the change identified by preview_id.

confirm_overwrite.description: Required (true) to change an open date or Case Value already set.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first result without a second write. Defaults to preview_id.

matter_id.description: Clio matter id (digits) from find_matter or list_open_matters. Not the display number.

matters.description: Up to 50 matters, each with its own fees and dates. Alternative to matter_id and its fees. One preview for all; blocked ones are skipped.

matter_id.description: Clio matter id (digits) from find_matter or list_open_matters. Not the display number.

open_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD hire date (first payment). Fee entries are dated to it. Defaults to the open date already in Clio, else today.

preview_id.description: preview_id is the id returned by this tool's preview call. Required when confirm is true.

retainer.description: True Availability Retainer (the down payment), dollars.

name: set_up_matter_billing
title: Set up matter billing
